source.title: DGX Spark final-test scorecards
source.description: 31-page final OCR test: English 6, Hindi 3, Marathi 22. CER-N follows OCR-D: grapheme-level Levenshtein edits divided by edits plus correctly aligned grapheme clusters (bounded 0–100%). NFC; whitespace, case, punctuation and Indic marks are retained. Ranking remains based on strict reference-length CER.
